milestone: M3 — Symbolic QA views and legal partials
claim: No decode-path integration, corpus build, training run, eval, benchmark, checkpoint, or ship claim. This records a capped/diagnostic-marked IDENTITY producer wrapper, a verified document-level COMPLETE_SUFFIX accepted-completion-set generator scored through the existing accepted_outputs membership path, an atomic-form reuse coverage checker, and two anti-identity hard-negative generators, plus the tests that pin the DSH1-08 acceptance criteria.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Identity rows obey the declared cap
Every atomic production appears in a nonidentity task
acceptance_criteria.evidence: test_every_lexical_atomic_form_also_appears_nonidentity (checked on scope_corpus + this module's COMPLETE_SUFFIX records combined); test_coverage_violation_detected_when_a_form_is_identity_only (negative control proving the checker detects a real gap)
acceptance_criteria.note: Coverage is checked as combined scope_corpus + COMPLETE_SUFFIX output; scope_corpus's own families alone do not close this gap for every fixture, which is exactly what COMPLETE_SUFFIX is for.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All accepted completions replay to verified terminals
acceptance_criteria.note: Covers the document-level statement-boundary COMPLETE_SUFFIX split only, not a tokenizer/CompletionForest-backed mid-expression prefix split; see Reopen conditions in the paired markdown.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No arbitrary single-gold label is used where several completions are accepted
acceptance_criteria.evidence: accepted_completion_outputs/complete_suffix_record persist every verified accepted member via ExampleRecord.accepted_outputs; test_accepted_completion_outputs_excludes_only_the_canonical_member; test_legally_continuing_peer_suffix_is_accepted
